messages:
Ravi P (Product): Quick sync 7: we need to finalize the GA guardrails doc today. Goals: clear SLA buckets, monitoring acceptance, docs + runbooks, pricing safety nets. Brief and actionable.

Nadia T (ENG): ACK. Can we define SLA buckets now? I suggest: small (<=512 tokens), medium (513-2048), long (>2048). Different p95 targets per bucket.

Jon W (SRE): Agree on buckets. For hosted: p95 targets = small: <150ms, medium: <280ms, long: <600ms. Error rate <0.25% daily. We need synthetic probes in 3 regions.

Evan K (FinOps): Pricing guardrail: propose 3-tier scenario. Pilot cap = 0.8x current hosted baseline cost per 1k tokens. If projected GA cost >1.1x baseline, flag for review. Need approval flow for exceptions.

Maya R (Docs): I'll prepare the GA docs checklist (Quickstart, SDK examples, migration notes, SLA page, known-issues, rollback steps). Drop the final SLA table and I'll slot it in.

Ravi P (Product): Good. Also need rollout phases: Canary (2% selected tenants), Beta (20% same-week ramp), GA cut (up to 30% first 14 days), full GA after 30 days if metrics stable. Rollback triggers: sustained 5xx >0.5% for 30m, billing >1.25x projection for 1h, or eval regression on core prompt set (drop in BLEU/acc >5%).

Nadia T (ENG): Will add automated eval job to CI to surface quality regressions. Also will add sequence-length weighted p95 telemetry so SLAs per bucket are measurable.

Jon W (SRE): Monitoring acceptance checklist (draft):
1) Synthetic probes regionally (NA/W EU/APAC) hitting representative sequences
2) Tracing: end-to-end request spans including model-kv tail latency
3) Billing telemetry: per-model, per-route token counts with cardinality limits
4) Alerts: high-latency (p95>threshold for 10m), elevated 5xx (>0.3% 15m), token-exhaust (cache/memory failures)
5) On-call runbook linked and tested via playbook drill

Sam O (Ops): Oncall/runbook: need explicit commands for emergency fallback and traffic-split. I want the rota for the 14-day ramp posted before GA cut.

rota-bot: Rota for GA ramp published at https://oncall.internal/ga-rota (lead: Sam; escalation: Jon -> Nadia -> Evan).

Maya R (Docs): Example emergency fallback snippet I'll include: 

``
# emergency: route traffic to fallback model set
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.internal/v1/routes -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"route":"model-fallback-v1","percent":100}'
```

Evan K (FinOps): Also need a short sensitivity table in the GA doc: base (expected), high (1.1x compute), extreme (1.5x compute). This informs pricing throttles and commercial hooks. I'll add a sheet to the planning doc.

Ravi P (Product): Owner summary: @Nadia SLA numbers + telemetry hooks; @Jon monitoring checklist + alerts; @Maya docs + runbooks; @Evan pricing scenarios + exception flow; @Sam oncall rota + rollback drills. I'll compile and request stakeholder sign-off at 16:00.

Nadia T (ENG): SLA draft will be posted to the planning doc by 11:30.

Maya R (Docs): Docs skeleton by 17:00.

Jon W (SRE): Monitoring checklist and initial alert thresholds by EOD. I'll also schedule a 72h burn-in in staging for the GA QPS profile; need ENG help to run it.

Nadia T (ENG): We can schedule the burn-in starting tonight in staging. I'll coordinate with Jon and Sam.

Sam O (Ops): I'll validate runbook commands and run a smoke drill tomorrow morning with oncall.

Evan K (FinOps): Exception approval matrix: I'll propose tiered approvals (TL -> Dir -> CFO) depending on delta. Will post by 13:00.

deploy-bot: Staging smoke passed @1743232000. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/1743232000

Ravi P (Product): If anyone hits a blocker call it out here now. Otherwise I'm moving this into the GA playbook after sign-off. :thumbsup:
